summary: postinstall exfiltrates host identifiers and full environment to attacker-controlled OAST domain
details: On npm install, the package's postinstall hook executes index.js, which collects host identifiers (os.hostname(), os.arch(), install path, os.userInfo() username) and serializes the entire process.env as comma-joined key=value pairs, then sends the aggregate via an HTTPS GET query string to the hardcoded host zuxsp9k9vyk5y45z1n2hv0orhin9b2zr.oastify.com (a Burp Collaborator / OAST subdomain). The bulk process.env dump captures any secret environment variables present on the installer's machine at install time (CI tokens, cloud credentials, registry auth tokens, database credentials).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
